title: Nsrahwɛfo a Wɔyɛ Nwanwa a Wɔkɔɔ Kurow a Wɔato Afasu So Mu
intro: Kuw bi duu kurow bi a na emufo nnim nokware da no apon ano. Wɔde nkrasɛm bae, nanso ɛhɔfo no danee atamfo, na wɔde basabasayɛ hunahunaa wɔn. Nanso, efi baabi a na wɔnhwɛ kwan no, ɛnne biako sɔree de yii ahɔho no ano, na ɛmaa nsɛm no danee wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nwonwa so.
clues: Yɛhyɛn kurow bi a na gyidi a wonni ahyɛ ne nkurɔfo so.
Wɔde adwenem naayɛ hwɛɛ yɛn na wɔkaa sɛ, ‘Moyɛ nnipa mpapahwekwa te sɛ yɛn ara kwa.’
Yɛbɔɔ wɔn kɔkɔ, nanso wɔmaa abo so tiaa yɛn.
Ɔbarima bi de ahopere fii kurow no ano a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri sɛ ɔrebesi yɛn nokware no so dua.
Ɔka kyerɛɛ ne nkurɔfo sɛ, ‘Adɛn nti na ɛnsɛ sɛ mesom Nea ɔbɔɔ me no?’
Kurow no pow no baa awiei wɔ ɔtopae biako pɛ mu, na kommyɛ dii tumi wɔ baabi a bere bi na wodi ho fɛw no.

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
